# Toolroll

> Toolroll is an open-source (MIT) control plane for unattended coding agents: Claude Code, Codex and Gemini run on your own machine or a team server. Every task gets a scope a person approves before work starts; the result comes back Ready with the diff, the project's check on the exact commit, and screenshots. Agents drive it through the `toolroll` CLI (JSON envelopes, stable reasons, exit codes 0/1/2/3, idempotency keys) or an MCP gateway. Approvals always belong to people.

Install with `npm install -g toolroll` (Node 22.13+, git, macOS or Linux), start with `toolroll up`, try `npx toolroll demo`. The installed binary is the authoritative reference: `toolroll --help`, `toolroll contract --commands --json`, `toolroll skills get operating`.

## For agents

- [Toolroll for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/agents.md): the machine contract, skills, task add/scope/wait with exit codes, status, results, MCP tools, and the rules
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/getting-started.md): install, onboard a repository, the console and terminal walkthroughs
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/security.md): approvals, the agent fence, permissions, secrets, API tokens, the action ledger

## Docs

- [Docs index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/README.md): every guide
- [Tasks, results and revisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/tasks.md): the loop, the lead, Ready and Complete
- [Chat and your phone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/chat-and-phone.md): the lead, subagents, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Teams
- [Flows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/flows.md): zones, cards, triggers, schedules, webhooks
- [Steps that reach outside](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/steps-outside.md): Jev sorting, drafts, web requests, email, tools
- [Code in flows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/code.md): scripts as steps and triggers
- [Subagents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/subagents.md): the lead's named helpers and their rules
- [Running unattended](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/unattended.md): guarantees, the queue, claims and leases, `tick`, the background builder
- [Fleets and trackers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/fleet.md): scanning repositories, worker queues, operating modes, GitHub and beads
- [Quality and agent routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/guide/routing.md): which model plans, builds and repairs, and why
- [Models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/MODELS.md): model lists and default agents
- [A team server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ap9000/toolroll/main/docs/team-server.md): one host, HTTPS, per-person tokens, MCP over HTTP
